column1: # What bringing Up Your Arsenal (PAL, SCES_524.56) up to its main menu worked out: functions and
# data of boot_elf (core.text 0x116F80-0x13D420, the front end's .text 0x381080-0x3F2778), with
# PAL addresses. For the later backfill and naming (rac3-decomp's config/names.tsv). The library
# entry points the port answers are in libraries.tsv, each with how it was identified; they are
# not repeated here unless more is known.

the game the disc's loader carries, WAD-compressed: 18 records (address, size, type, entry 0x0013ADA8): type 1 code/data (0x00100080 the VU microcode, 0x00116F80 core.text, 0x00381080 .text, the rest data as boot_elf.elf's sections), type 8 zeros (bss 0x00152400, 0x001D9880), 0x70000006 register-use (0x00100000, 0x003F2780); hostgen reads it from the disc (hostgen.json asm loader, retail.py loader_parts)
